title: Handler
description: Something that takes an input and answers, escalates or waits; ranked by its measured cost per call.

kind.description: script, hook, rule, model, session or person

entry.description: the registered name of its implementation

component.description: its part on a map, if any

cost.description: mean cost per call: person, usd, seconds

measured.description: whether cost comes from its calls (false: its kind's prior)

rank.description: its place on the ladder, 1 cheapest

scored.description: answers whose input's outcome is known

correct.description: scored answers that matched the outcome
